questions.q: What was planned on the site of Block 27?
questions.e: In the video: "planirana gradnja velikog stambenog naselja" — construction of a large housing estate was planned.

questions.q: What are the city stories about?
o: Underground tunnels, military facilities and strange phenomena
questions.e: In the video: "o tajnim podzemnim tunelima, vojnim objektima i čudnim pojavama" — about secret underground tunnels, military facilities and strange phenomena.

questions.q: Why did construction really stop, according to experts?
questions.e: In the video: "razlog odustajanja od gradnje bili močvarno zemljište i tehnički problemi" — the reason for abandoning construction was marshy ground and technical problems.

questions.q: Whom does this empty space attract today?
o: Lovers of urban legends and mysteries
questions.e: In the video: "privlači pažnju ljubitelja urbanih legenda i misterija" — attracts the attention of lovers of urban legends and mysteries.

sections.title: Vocabulary
sections.about: Words from the video and their translations

questions.q: teren naglo i bez zvaničnog objašnjenja ostao *neizgrađen*
ovaj *prazan* prostor u srcu Novog Beograda
Iako stručnjaci *objašnjavaju* da su razlog odustajanja

questions.e: Misterija (of what?) takes the genitive: bloka.
The preposition o ("about") takes the locative: o tunelima.
The preposition od ("from") takes the genitive: od gradnje.

questions.q: ovaj prazan prostor u ___ Novog Beograda
questions.e: The preposition u ("in") answering "where?" takes the locative: u srcu.
